verdict.rationale: Shopify's agent docs are served as raw markdown: a probe returned HTTP 200 for shopify.dev/docs/agents.md with frontmatter, and the agent doc pages are cited at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at clean, agent-readable docs. An AI Toolkit plugin/skill also maps natural-language requests to UCP CLI commands, and the underlying UCP spec publishes an llms.txt index at ucp.dev. Missing for 10: an llms.txt at shopify.dev (probe returned 404), a published OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and explicit first-party documentation that the markdown docs are intended for agent consumption.
